receiverDaemon.warning: Published waved release binaries are default builds with no RELEASE_TAGS and do not expose the required wallet RPC surface; build the pinned source target.

jvmBolt11Decoder.decision: approved for the isolated Phase 0 spike
jvmBolt11Decoder.verified: BOLT 11 specification vector decoded amount, payment hash, timestamp, explicit expiry and checksum corruption on Java 25
risks: Large Kotlin/Ktor transitive graph for a decoder-only use
Native secp256k1 JNI loads with a Java 25 native-access warning
BOLT11 lntb identifies the testnet family, not signet independently

browserBolt11Decoder.decision: approved for the isolated Phase 0 T6 browser harness
browserBolt11Decoder.reason: Pinned browser ESM export with checksum/network/amount/hash/expiry decoding; T6 checked a synthetic signed signet-family fixture and malformed/wrong-network cases. It intentionally does not independently validate invoice signatures.
browserBolt11Decoder.liveGate: Cross-check a real v0.1.1 signet invoice during T7; no live invoice was used in T6.

browserL402.decision: approved only for the isolated Phase 0 T6 narrow local boundary after separate Keel approval and fresh-context review
browserL402.implementation: Strictly parse Paygate exact version=0 L402 challenge syntax; require identical canonical token/macaroon values, a bounded verified BOLT11, and format only L402 <macaroon>:<64-hex-preimage>. No generic codec, auto-paying client, wallet adapter, or credential persistence.

evaluated.result: Reject as a browser integration dependency: root exports include Node-only wallet modules; its custom Wallet payInvoice contract also cannot represent prepare/dispatch/reconcile recovery. Its parser/header builder may inform a later reviewed narrow choice.
Reject: last release 2024-05-13 and its Axios flow dispatches and retries without the required durable unknown-outcome state machine.

browserL402.gate: The local surface remains spike-only and requires fresh-context security review. Both evaluated packages remain rejected; production use needs a separately approved maintained browser-safe dependency or security decision.

documentedApiCandidates.recovery: T6 implements one-dispatch recovery over prepareSend/sendPrepared plus subscribe/startActivity(includeExisting) and bounded list, keyed only by the persisted payment hash; real replay remains T7 live required.

liveGates: payer preimage is emitted and hash-valid for an externally supplied invoice
includeExisting replay recovers that preimage after reload and a lost send response
exactly one dispatch occurs during recovery and timeout is not misclassified as cancellation
receiver activity reconstructs every Invoice field after waved restart within the declared lookup envelope
Status.ready behavior during coordinator and swap outages
actual receive mode, asset, fee, control, redemption and exit properties
real signet BOLT11 and complete serialized HTTP header sizes
browser wallet-start/nested-worker/OPFS quota and persistence behavior across declared browsers; T6 observed runtime-ready only in pinned Chromium

browserHarness.status: T6 offline capability harness verified; payer preimage and post-reload replay remain unpassed T7 live gates

storage.record: schema v1 invoice, macaroon, exact GET target, payment hash, amount, verified expiry, creation time, dispatch_may_have_occurred=true
storage.security: Readable by same-origin scripts; macaroon and payment metadata are confidential capability context but cannot authorize without a preimage. No preimage or assembled Authorization value is persisted.
storage.lifecycle: Survives same-tab reload; does not promise recovery after tab/profile storage loss. Corruption or access failure blocks dispatch/recovery; cleanup follows protected 200 or explicit warned abandonment.

sdkShapes.dispatch: sendPrepared(PrepareSendResult) -> SendResult{entry,actualAmountSat,paymentHash?}; result is initial activity, not terminal settlement
sdkShapes.recovery: Match only persisted paymentHash through supported replay/list. Never persist or replay sendIntentId and never call sendPrepared during recovery.

cleanProfileObserved.runtime: Pinned v0.1.1 archive and all eight assets passed SHA-256 validation; createWebClient.ready() reached runtime_ready without wallet administration
cleanProfileObserved.context: loopback HTTP was a secure context with WebAssembly, Worker, Web Crypto, Web Locks, OPFS API presence, and crossOriginIsolated=true
cleanProfileObserved.storage: A synthetic sessionStorage marker survived same-tab reload in a temporary clean persistent Chromium profile
cleanProfileObserved.limits: No wallet create/unlock/start, funded payment, terminal preimage replay, nested SQLite worker use, storage quota/persistence, or individual-header necessity was established.
